capabilities: Format text with a ribbon toolbar
Insert and edit tables, equations, and Mermaid diagrams via forms
Switch between Word mode, Markdown, and reading view
Edit properties, images, links, and footnotes visually
Provide touch trackpad and control keys on phones
disambiguation: Not a separate document format or exporter; notes stay plain Markdown files edited in place.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.5.7 or later; installed manually from a release. README lists known limitations: Android and iPad untested on real hardware, some Markdown/reading-mode toolbar buttons untested, non-Chinese/English translations unreviewed, and Arabic/Hebrew keep left-to-right layout. No telemetry, accounts, or payment; network use only loads web content notes already reference.
problem: Obsidian's Markdown editor requires memorizing syntax and offers no ribbon toolbar for formatting, tables, equations, or diagrams.
summary: Word-processor-style editor that adds a ribbon toolbar, tables, equations, and diagram forms while saving notes as plain Markdown.
